scope: Read-only independent comparison of all 36 unchanged PDFs / 1477 pages against original production9f8 raw analyses replanned with current772; no native workers or baseline detection.
sourceExpectations: Reuse exact frozen prior source/profile/PDF-geometry bindings after hashing all originals again. Same source-owned expectations; unresolved pages and zero-band profiles do not count as successful extraction.
checks: All source hashes, executable and Core, page geometry and staff identity/order, every assignment and order, warnings/unresolved metadata, all crop edges, per-band foreign-staff ID sets, component changes and unresolved coverage.
visualReviewReuse: A prior visual source crop finding may only be reused if source byte hash, physical page, intended assignment/candidate IDs, and both crop rectangles match exactly. Changed geometry needs new source review.
newSourceGates: New foreign-staff relation is a failure even if aggregate improves. Inward changes are queued for original-source inspection; no blanket source preservation claim from bounds alone.
